reviews.x: I bought my 2 year old this drum set for his birthday not even 2 days ago. It doesn't stay upright, every time he is going to use it, it falls to the sides. Never stays upright. The actual drums are clipped to each other so when he hits one it falls and so do the other ones. Would not recommend this drum set at all!! Waste of my money....
Terrible! The plastic piece to keep cymbal in place was missing! And drums are not sturdy. Kept falling over. And will not stay attached. In the trash within thirty minutes of opening. Do not buy!!
It doesn’t stay together falling apart all the time would not recommend this looks cheap!

reviews.t: Thought it was a great idea for our 3 year old
reviews.x: Bought it for our grandson who is 3yrs old. Thought it may be a great drum set for his age. He hit it a few times and the edges of it started to crumble into small glass pieces that were very sharp. For me I do not recommend.

I bought this for my 4 year old son's birthday. It was rather cheaply made with thick plastic clips that had to be pried apart to be able to put it together. The sides of the drums are cardboard. Every time my son hit his cymbal, it dented. It got to the point that we had to literally push it back into shape. It looks cute, but is not very durable.

Didn't come with directions, so went by picture on box. Plastic pieces that connect drums together are delicate. Two of mine broke, so I ended up using screws. Best to use screws anyway, cause those plastic pieces don't hold anything
This items is totally not adjustable , just fall frequently and broke easily . I dont refer anyone  for this item.
GGGGGGARBAGE. If you don’t mind putting it back together every 5 seconds, literally then go ahead and purchase.

reviews.t: Pay attention to measurements and descriptions.
reviews.x: Smaller than I had expected. One drum wouldn’t stay attached. Ok for 2-3 year olds.

reviews.t: Not worth it, find another one.
reviews.x: Very cheap and micro size way to small for a toddler.

I am extremely disappointed with this product. Very poor quality plastic, drum stand broke during set up. Set up is flimsy drums hardly stay clamped to each other even when my 4 year old lightly hits the drums. Symbol doesn't stay on its pole since there is no cap to screw in like in the pictures. This is the last time I buy a Christmas gift from Amazon. 5$ and below quality for 30+ dollars I could have bought this at the. 5 and below store. Purchased this for my 2yr old grandson.missing parts..i was going to send back but he cried when i took it back amd pit in box....so we just accepted it because he wouldve been too heartbroken and i couldnt stand to see him cry plus his bday was the next day and i wouldnt have a gift for him.He loves drums..so i just count as loss for me but gain for him

This item came with broken parts. To set it up the parts would not snap together .My son was bummed when it did not work properly because things were broken and i could not return it because he ripped open the box from excitement on his birthday. I would recommend to spend the extra money because this one was a disappointment

Never again. Received today and it was broken the same day. Not worth the price we paid for. Highly recommended not for children age 2 and up. My son loves to play drums and hit on things, he didn’t get to enjoy his drums before it was ripped. He was playing the drum when the plastic cover on top ripped.

reviews.t: Not worth the money for a kid.
reviews.x: I know this was a 30 dollar toddler size drum set. With that in mind, the drums held together for all of 2 minutes of my kid playing with it. Then the snaps were bent or broke. After that they were used as bowls. The stool would hold a teddy bear reliably. A toddler not so much.

Product has been slowly falling apart day by day. My son has played with it twice. Every time I walk into the room something else seem to have fallen off and is laying on the floor.  The set is not very stable either. Would not recommend.

This drum set is very cheap. The hinges to attach the side drums broke off, or were already broken. Not worth $40.00. Not very sturdy at all. The drum set kept leaning and falling over while my grandson was playing with it.

reviews.t: Thrown away the day after Christmas
reviews.x: I guess I missed the dimension the things fit for like a two year old bought it for a 4yo. Not very sturdy thing fell apart quickly. Reminds me of a family dollar 5.00 toy rather a 30.00 purchase. Maybe it’s the recession.

Don't waste your time or money.  This"drum set" is just plastic stretched over cardboard. The "drums" are very small. Seriously my dinner plates are bigger by 2 inches around and they're only 10and3/4 inches in size.

Easy to assemble. Great purchase. I bought it for my youngest nephew and he plays it so horribly and loudly that it drives my little sister and brother-in-law crazy so it’s a WIN for me!!!! Paybacks and all 😉🤷‍♀️

I cannot wait to give this to my niece for Christmas....It is so cute....In fact my husband was playing with it for one hour before I put it away....It is very cute and for the price well worth it....
3 young grandsons drumming almost nonstop for days and the little set held up. Their Mom has since hid it from them. I wonder why?. The drum set will still be great when she gets her sanity back
The product is was not for an three and up age. It is for a one year old; very disappointment. I bought it for my three year old grand baby and had to give it away to my neighbors child.
This product is cheap, I assembled it and it’s not sturdy at all. My two year old couldn’t play with it because it falls off. Will not recommend at all. I had to return it.
Super difficult to put together. Doesnt come with any directions. Just a few very vague pictures on the side of the box. And it super flimsy. But it works for a little one.

claims.text: The drum set does not stay together or upright, with drums and cymbals frequently falling apart during play.
The product is cheaply made with flimsy plastic parts that break easily, including broken or missing pieces on arrival.
The drums are smaller than expected and reviewers consider it poor value for the price.
Some reviewers report safety concerns, such as sharp crumbling edges and parts breaking during setup.
Assembly is difficult, with delicate plastic connectors and no directions included.
